Accommodation Faro Sardo Sardinia
Book Your Stay in Sardinia
Born from a dream who fell in love with Sardinia, Faro Sardo is a unique Bed and Breakfast created from the careful restoration of an house with the shape of a lighthouse, just a few meters from the beach in Quartu, only minutes from Cagliari.
Today, this modern and welcoming B&B combines contemporary comfort with the wild beauty of the Mediterranean coast — offering sea views, peaceful surroundings, and Sardinian hospitality. A special place where nature, sport, and relaxation meet, perfect for travelers looking for more than just accommodation, but a true experience by the sea.

Faro Sardo About Us - Faro Sardo
Skip to content
Faro Sardo About Us
Opening a guest house in a corner of paradise had long been a dream of mine, and in many ways it felt like the most natural path to follow. I wanted to create a place where guests could slow down, relax, and experience the beauty of Sardinia in a warm and welcoming atmosphere : I call it “Unplugged holydays”
Hospitality has always been part of who I am. I genuinely enjoy welcoming people and making them feel at home from the moment they arrive.
I am also a sports enthusiast and always happy to suggest, or even accompany guests on activities such as cycling along the sunny coastal roads or exploring the peaceful trails of the inland countryside. And for those who love the sea, the beautiful beaches nearby are perfect for unforgettable kitesurfing sessions.
My daughter, Natakan, brings a joyful spirit to our home. She loves the outdoors, the sea, and making new friends, and she is always happy to share the simple pleasures of beach life. For this reason, families are especially welcome, and we will do our best to ensure that both adults and children feel comfortable and at ease.
Our B&B Vision
After traveling across Italy for many years, the idea of opening a guest house in Sardinia had always stayed with me. I dreamed of creating a place where guests could relax, enjoy the sea, and experience the authentic atmosphere of the island.
My first trip to Sardinia in 2009 was a true revelation. The sunshine, the beaches, the food, and the warm hospitality of the people immediately captured our hearts. From that moment on, we knew that one day we wanted to build our life here.
The next step was to find the perfect location: a house close to Cagliari, near the airport, and just steps from the sea . When we found a place where the beach was only 30 meters away , we knew we had found exactly what we were looking for.
Today, the values that guide our B&B are simple: hospitality, sharing, relaxation, and a homemade breakfast prepared with care. Our goal is to welcome every guest as they deserve and to help them enjoy an unforgettable stay in South Sardinia .

Sardinia Accommodation - Faro Sardo
Skip to content
Sardinia Accommodation
South Sardinia is one of the most attractive areas of the island, known for its crystal clear sea, long sandy beaches, and authentic Mediterranean atmosphere. From the lively city of Cagliari to the unspoiled coastline of Villasimius and Chia , this region offers a perfect balance between nature, culture, and relaxation, making it an ideal destination for a holiday in Sardinia.
Faro Sardo enjoys a particularly strategic position in the heart of the Gulf of Cagliari , allowing guests to easily reach some of the most beautiful beaches and points of interest in South Sardinia . Staying in this central location means you can explore different parts of the coast without long driving times, whether you want to visit historic Cagliari , discover scenic coastal roads, or spend the day on quiet beaches surrounded by nature.
Perfect Location for Active Tourism in South Sardinia
Thanks to its position in the Gulf of Cagliari, Faro Sardo is also an excellent choice for visitors who enjoy active tourism in Sardinia . The area is well known for its ideal wind conditions and open coastal spaces, making it perfect for windsurfing and kitesurfing , especially along the nearby beaches.
The surroundings are equally suitable for running and cycling , with scenic coastal roads, seaside promenades, and quiet routes that allow you to train while enjoying panoramic views of the sea and the Mediterranean landscape. Whether you prefer water sports or outdoor activities on land, this part of South Sardinia offers the right conditions almost all year round.
Staying at Faro Sardo means combining relaxation by the sea with the opportunity to stay active and explore the natural beauty of the island in a healthy and enjoyable way.
Faro Sardo also offers guests the possibility of using two bicycles, available on site, making it easy to move around the area and explore the surroundings in a comfortable and eco-friendly way.
